diagnostic_tail: Dopamine cluster publisher error: Dopamine cluster draft rejected: The article omits the documented iOS 26.0 through iOS 26.0.1 compatibility range for A12 and A13 devices. Because the page presents itself as a central Dopamine 3 compatibility reference and repeatedly summarizes the supported ranges, this omission makes the compatibility coverage incomplete.; The statement that A12/A13 devices are listed from iOS 15.0 through iOS 18.7.1 is incomplete without clarifying the additional, separate iOS 26.0–26.0.1 range. It should not imply that iOS 18.7.1 is the final A12/A13 endpoint.
